出版者的话
古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适时适所地以适当方式对适当对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”而我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地对适当对象恰如其分地表达情绪。
现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。
情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养，而幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期。一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。
当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露就能生根、发芽。
这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。
让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧！

Publisher's Note
The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry, and that's not difficult. But to be angry at the right time, in the right place, in the right way, and with the right person, to the right degree—that's difficult.' What we now call emotional management is precisely about expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time and place, toward the right person, and to the right extent.
In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills, because those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this skill, although possibly intelligent, often struggle in their endeavors.
While emotional management skills are partly influenced by innate factors, they ultimately depend on learning and cultivation. Early childhood is the golden period for developing emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits formed during this period create permanent neural connections in the brain, profoundly influencing a child's physical and mental development.
Currently, the method of cultivating emotional management skills through parent-child reading of emotional management picture books is widely recognized. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried by parents' voices into children's ears, taking root in their hearts, and with sunlight and rain, they can grow and sprout.
This series of heartwarming animal picture storybooks is designed to address specific emotional topics for children, depicting their inner journeys and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a reference for parents during parent-child reading.
Let us enjoy a wonderful parent-child reading journey with this series!

page_text_en:
Teacher Says to You
Fly with Your Own Wings
The protagonist of this story, Clotilde, is a plump, round little owl.
She lives happily with her friends and family in a beautiful forest. She has her strengths—
singing and cooking. However, she also has many flaws common to girls—she’s quite timid.
Clotilde’s parents are truly “heartless”; they send the little owl to summer camp alone. You see, she’s never been away from her parents for such a long time before! Still, Clotilde’s crying didn’t change her parents’ minds, so she had to set off bravely. At this point, I truly felt anxious for this little owl. But then, as I continued reading, things took a “turning point”—Clotilde eventually overcame her timidity and shyness, gaining confidence and independence. The summer camp experience became the most beautiful memory of her life.
Today’s children are often “doted on” and “coddled” by their parents and grandparents, with everything done for them. They try to make children more comfortable and happier. Unbeknownst to them, this actually places children in a “greenhouse,” making them unable to withstand life’s storms. Once they enter society, children often cannot face difficulties and problems objectively, and lack the ability to solve problems using their own strength.
Protecting children is certainly a family’s important responsibility, but overprotection becomes an obstacle to their growth, and even a deep harm to them. As a mother, I deeply admire the owl’s mother for having the “courage” to push her child out, letting her face the unknown independently.

作者对于克洛蒂尔德出发前的描写非常到位：她是那么恐惧与不安，吓哭了，还借助看电视来放松；同学们的误导令她不知所措，她不得不躲进了学校的医务室……所有这些描写与小猫头鹰真正的夏令营生活形成了强烈的反差——原来夏令营是那么有趣，外面的世界是那么精彩！原来，小猫头鹰最需要战胜的敌人就是自己！
下面，让我们和克洛蒂尔德一起去参加夏令营吧！一路上不仅有很多有趣的事情，还能领略到雪山、沙漠以及热带草原的美丽风光。

（保定市教科所教研员 刘育红）
page_text_en:
Challenge. Clotilde's mother loves her child wisely; she knows that a child sheltered under parental protection will never truly grow up. Moreover, parents cannot always be by their child's side. Ultimately, children must learn to solve problems in life on their own.
"A jade uncarved is not a vessel"—only through some trials and hardships can a child's "wings" become stronger and fuller, developing the inner strength to overcome difficulties. During a child's growth, wise parents can offer guidance, reminders, and advice, helping them face challenges "in the background" and serving as their strongest support.
The author's description of Clotilde before her departure is very vivid: she was so fearful and anxious, even crying, and turned to watching TV to relax; her classmates' misinformation left her confused, forcing her to hide in the school's infirmary... All these descriptions form a strong contrast with the actual fun-filled summer camp life of the little owl—turns out, summer camp is so enjoyable, and the outside world is so wonderful! In fact, the biggest enemy the little owl must overcome is herself!
Now, let's join Clotilde on her summer camp adventure! Along the way, there are many fun experiences, and we can also enjoy the beautiful scenery of snow-capped mountains, deserts, and tropical grasslands.
When reading this story, my fifteen-year-old daughter was about to leave home for a long journey. Unlike little Clotilde at the beginning, my daughter was full of confidence and eagerly anticipated her upcoming life. Finally, I would like to dedicate this story and my blessings to all lovely and strong girls in the world!
(Researcher, Baoding City Education Research Institute, Liu Yuhong)

医务室的刺猬阿姨特别和蔼可亲，

刺猬阿姨安慰她说：
“我的好宝贝，不要听他们的。他们嫉妒你，才乱说的。

刺猬阿姨给小猫头鹰喂了一片大大的饼干，

Originally, little Clotilde had hidden in the school's infirmary.
The hedgehog aunt in the infirmary was especially kind and gentle.
Seeing the trembling little owl, the hedgehog aunt comforted her:
"My dear, don't listen to them. They're jealous of you, that's why they're making things up.
You'll see, the summer camp is going to be fantastic."

The hedgehog aunt fed the little owl a big cookie,
and Clotilde seemed to be convinced.

Today's goal is to explore the mountains,

Skiing on the mountain is fun, especially using a small sled,
and little Clotilde rolled around in the snow several times!

Finally, the ground squirrel on the mountain prepared
a steaming cup of hot chocolate milk for the little owl,
which was truly delightful!
summary_zh: 本页描述了小猫头鹰克洛蒂尔德在夏令营中探索雪山、滑雪并打滚的欢乐经历，最后在土拨鼠的招待下喝到热巧克力牛奶，感到非常惬意。

There, the hospitable camels prepared delicious honey cakes and refreshing mint tea for them.

The sunset over the desert is so beautiful!
Little Clotilde doesn't regret coming to summer camp at all.

Camp was amazing!
